title: nan
authors: Urzua S.; Munguía R.; Nuño E.; Grau A.
key_contribution: Presents a minimalistic monocular SLAM system using a barometer for metric scale recovery applied to micro aerial vehicles in GPS-denied environments, with observability analysis and real data validation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Visual_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
